quests.instruction: Point to the food that is a citrus fruit you peel before splitting into slices.
quests.hint: You split it into juicy little sections.
quests.explanation: Well done! Orange is a citrus fruit you peel before splitting into slices.
quests.funFact: Oranges are citrus fruits protected by a thick, dimpled rind.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a food cut into triangles or squares for lunch.
quests.hint: It's a handheld meal, perfect for lunch on the go.
quests.explanation: Correct! Sandwich is a food cut into triangles or squares for lunch.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a sandwich is a food item made of ingredients placed between two slices of bread.

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is small round fruits that grow on a climbing vine?
quests.hint: They grow on a climbing plant called a vine.
quests.explanation: Super! Grapes is small round fruits that grow on a climbing vine.
quests.funFact: Raisins are just grapes that have been dried in the hot sun.

quests.instruction: Which food is a round fruit with a bumpy peel and sweet-tart juice?
quests.hint: It's citrusy, round, and full of juice.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Orange is a round fruit with a bumpy peel and sweet-tart juice.
quests.funFact: The color orange was actually named after the fruit, not the other way around.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a drink your body needs most to stay healthy?
quests.hint: Your body needs it more than any other drink.
quests.explanation: You found it! Water is a drink your body needs most to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Your body is actually made up of about 60% water.

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is a vegetable that turns into crispy chips when sliced thin?
quests.hint: Its skin is brown, and its inside is white.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Potato is a vegetable that turns into crispy chips when sliced thin.
quests.funFact: Potatoes are packed with potassium and vitamin C.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a heart-shaped red fruit that grows close to the ground?
quests.hint: It grows low to the ground on a small plant.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Strawberry is a heart-shaped red fruit that grows close to the ground.
quests.funFact: Strawberries are the first fruit to ripen in the spring.

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is a fruit you can freeze for a cool summer snack.
quests.hint: Popping a frozen one in your mouth feels cool.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Grapes is a fruit you can freeze for a cool summer snack.
quests.funFact: Grapes are toxic to dogs, so never share them with your pet!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a fruit that shares its name with its own color.
quests.hint: Its name is also the name of a color.
quests.explanation: Yes! Orange is a fruit that shares its name with its own color.
quests.funFact: They need a warm, sunny climate to grow properly.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a spreadable food that makes popcorn extra tasty.
quests.hint: It needs to sit out a bit before it's easy to spread.
quests.explanation: That's right! Butter is a spreadable food that makes popcorn extra tasty.
quests.funFact: Before electricity, churning butter was a very exhausting chore.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a warm breakfast food often topped with butter or jam?
quests.hint: It's a common way to enjoy bread at breakfast.
quests.explanation: Great job! Toast is a warm breakfast food often topped with butter or jam.
quests.funFact: Butter and jam are the most famous toppings for a slice of toast.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a creamy breakfast food often topped with granola.
quests.hint: It's smooth, creamy, and a popular breakfast food.
quests.explanation: You got it! Yogurt is a creamy breakfast food often topped with granola.
quests.funFact: Yogurt is packed with probiotics that help your stomach digest food.

quests.instruction: Tap the food that is a liquid pressed out of fruits like oranges or apples.
quests.hint: It's a favorite drink to pack for school lunch.
quests.explanation: Well done! Juice is a liquid pressed out of fruits like oranges or apples.
quests.funFact: 100% natural juice is much healthier than fruit drinks with added sugar.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a huge green fruit with juicy red insides.
quests.hint: Its outside is green, but its inside is a juicy pink.
quests.explanation: Correct! Watermelon is a huge green fruit with juicy red insides.
quests.funFact: Watermelons are one of the most popular summer picnic treats.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a round orange fruit with juicy sections inside.
quests.hint: Its peel is thick and a little bumpy.
quests.explanation: Super! Orange is a round orange fruit with juicy sections inside.
quests.funFact: Peeling an orange releases a burst of incredibly fragrant essential oils.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is tiny sweet fruits often dried into raisins.
quests.hint: Drying them out turns them into a wrinkly snack.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Grapes is tiny sweet fruits often dried into raisins.
quests.funFact: Did you know? grapes grow in large bunches on climbing plants called vines.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a clear drink that fills oceans, rivers, and lakes.
quests.hint: It fills up oceans, rivers, and lakes.
quests.explanation: You found it! Water is a clear drink that fills oceans, rivers, and lakes.
quests.funFact: Drinking water cools you down when you sweat.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a crunchy orange vegetable rabbits love to munch?
quests.hint: Cartoon rabbits are always shown munching on this.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Carrot is a crunchy orange vegetable rabbits love to munch.
quests.funFact: Bugs Bunny's favorite snack is a crunchy, raw carrot.

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a juicy fruit often squeezed to make morning juice?
quests.hint: It's often squeezed for a morning drink.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Orange is a juicy fruit often squeezed to make morning juice.
quests.funFact: Did you know? oranges are citrus fruits protected by a thick, dimpled rind.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a juicy red fruit often dipped in chocolate?
quests.hint: It's often dipped in melted chocolate as a treat.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Strawberry is a juicy red fruit often dipped in chocolate.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a strawberry is the only fruit that wears its seeds on the outside.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a fruity drink often found in a small box with a straw?
quests.hint: It often comes in a little box with a straw poked in.
quests.explanation: Yes! Juice is a fruity drink often found in a small box with a straw.
quests.funFact: Did you know? juice is the natural liquid extracted from fruits and vegetables.

quests.instruction: Which one is a soft yellow food made by churning cream?
quests.hint: It's made by churning cream until it turns solid.
quests.explanation: That's right! Butter is a soft yellow food made by churning cream.
quests.funFact: Did you know? butter is made simply by violently shaking or churning heavy cream.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a brown vegetable that grows underground and becomes fries.
quests.hint: It's dug up from under the soil, not picked from a branch.
quests.explanation: Great job! Potato is a brown vegetable that grows underground and becomes fries.
quests.funFact: Did you know? potatoes grow completely underground and are called tubers.

quests.instruction: Which food is a clear liquid that falls from clouds as rain?
quests.hint: It falls from the sky whenever it rains.
quests.explanation: You got it! Water is a clear liquid that falls from clouds as rain.
quests.funFact: Water has absolutely zero calories and zero sugar.

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is a big striped fruit that's mostly made of water?
quests.hint: It's mostly made of water, just like its name suggests.
quests.explanation: Well done! Watermelon is a big striped fruit that's mostly made of water.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a watermelon is completely accurately named because it is 92% water.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is warm crunchy bread that pops up when it's ready.
quests.hint: It starts soft, then turns warm, golden, and crunchy.
quests.explanation: Correct! Toast is warm crunchy bread that pops up when it's ready.
quests.funFact: Did you know? toast is bread that has been browned by exposure to radiant heat.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a smooth dairy food that comes in many fruity flavors.
quests.hint: It comes in a small cup and needs a spoon.
quests.explanation: Super! Yogurt is a smooth dairy food that comes in many fruity flavors.
quests.funFact: Freezing yogurt turns it into a delicious dessert similar to ice cream.

quests.instruction: Which one is a tangy, creamy food scooped from a small cup?
quests.hint: It's often topped with granola or fresh fruit.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Yogurt is a tangy, creamy food scooped from a small cup.
quests.funFact: Did you know? yogurt is made by adding healthy bacteria to warm milk.

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is the healthiest drink to have when you feel thirsty.
quests.hint: Doctors say it's the best drink for staying healthy.
quests.explanation: You found it! Water is the healthiest drink to have when you feel thirsty.
quests.funFact: Did you know? water is the single most essential substance for all life on Earth.

quests.instruction: Which food is a long orange vegetable that grows under the ground?
quests.hint: It grows hidden under the soil, not above it.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Carrot is a long orange vegetable that grows under the ground.
quests.funFact: Did you know? carrots are root vegetables that grow entirely underground.
